Retrieval and Synthesis

This is a small HTML fixture for the Phase 2 ingestion tests. The article body should survive boilerplate removal while the navigation and footer around it are discarded by the HTML adapter.

Page-First Retrieval

Page-first retrieval returns stable, citable wiki pages rather than raw chunks. Chunks remain only as a fallback when page coverage is thin for a given query, which keeps answers consistent as the corpus grows.

Compounding Knowledge

A maintained wiki compounds: every new source improves the pages it touches, so the same query gets better answers over time instead of drifting with whichever chunks happen to win.
